title: Data Transformation Pipeline Project
instructions: Build a comprehensive data processing pipeline using comprehensions to analyze sales data from multiple sources and generate various business intelligence reports.
steps: Load and parse sales data from CSV using list comprehensions with data validation
Load product information from JSON and create lookup dictionaries using dict comprehensions
Load employee data and create efficient lookup structures
Calculate key metrics: total revenue, profit, best-selling products using comprehensions
**Identify unique product categories using a set comprehension**
Generate various reports using appropriate comprehension patterns
**Use an explicit generator expression to calculate average transaction revenue**
